name: nais-platform
description: Knowledge and skills for engineers who build the Nais platform: the Nais API, tenants and environment clusters, Fasit features, Terraform, and the Loki/Mimir/Tempo observability stack.

cplt.reason: The nais-observability skill queries Mimir, Loki and Tempo at *.cloud.nais.io, which resolve to private IP addresses over naisdevice. The tenant gate reads naisdevice's own status file to tell which tenant you are connected to; without it the gate cannot enforce tenant rules inside the sandbox.
